 Chelsea vs Man Utd LIVE: Goalless in blockbuster clash at sunny Stamford Bridge 
 Chelsea vs Man Utd LIVE: Goalless in blockbuster clash at sunny Stamford Bridge
 Flashscore Updated Chelsea are hosting Manchester United Action Images via Reuters/Peter Cziborra / Flashscore The latest round of the Premier League season is here, and it's starting with a bang, with Chelsea and Manchester United contesting a clash at Stamford Bridge. With Xabi Alonso's side licking their wounds after back-to-back defeats to Tottenham and Liverpool, and the Red Devils on an eight-match winless run, it's a clash that both sides will be desperate to win, and one that could spell the end of United boss Michael Carrick.
 Listen to live audio commentary here! 
 Live updates:
 13:52 CET - 20 minutes in and the game is still 0-0, but Chelsea have certainly had the lion's share of possession. However, United have looked really dangerous on the break.
 Momentum graph Flashscore 13:46 CET - Chelsea thought they had the opening goal of the game, but Estevao was offside after tapping the ball home from close range. The Brazilian has been really lively so far.
 Estevao after his goal was ruled out for offside Action Images via Reuters / Peter Cziborra 13:31 CET - And we are underway at Stamford Bridge! Let's hope for a good one!
 Win probability Flashscore 13:09 CET - To no one's surprise, Cole Palmer takes his place in the Chelsea side after missing the game against Liverpool in the Carabao Cup due to being sent off against Tottenham last weekend. They will need a far better performance from their talisman following a pretty inconsistent start to the campaign. 
 Palmer's last six matches Flashscore 12:58 CET - There is a little bit of good news for Manchester United today, though, as Kobbie Mainoo is fit enough to make his return to the bench. Could he play an important part later in the game?
 12:20 CET - The teams are in from Stamford Bridge, and there is some very interesting news for both sides.
 As reported a few days ago, Manchester United captain  Bruno Fernandes is back in the starting XI having held clear-the-air talks with manager Michael Carrick . As a result, Youri Tielemans is dropped to the bench.
 Meanwhile, amidst all the noise surrounding Estevao 's lack of game time under Xabi Alonso , the 19-year-old starts for Chelsea ! A big opportunity for the Brazilian, while the Blues also look to be without a number nine on the pitch in the absence of Joao Pedro .
 Team line-ups Flashscore 11:00 CET - Hello and welcome to Flashscore's live coverage of a Premier League blockbuster between Chelsea and Manchester United! 
 The two English giants are getting the ball rolling this weekend, and while it may not be a top-of-the-table clash as it has been so many times in the past, it's a crucial one nonetheless.
 The sides' positions and form Flashscore That's especially the case for under-fire Michael Carrick , who is somewhat surprisingly still the Man Utd boss given his side extended their winless run to eight games last time out with a 3-0 defeat at home to Bournemouth . Another heavy defeat today would surely spell the end for him.
 Things aren't anywhere near as precarious for Xabi Alonso, but the Chelsea faithful will be expecting nothing less than a win at Stamford Bridge today after watching their side be dominated and beaten by rivals Tottenham last weekend before losing to Liverpool on penalties in the EFL Cup.
 Kick-off is at 13:30 CET, and we'll be posting the team news and live updates throughout the match right here.
